description: S14: Queen and Pawn on the real board (rules/boards/standard-9x9.json, rules/pieces/) under the draft 2-player ruleset. Expected moves come from plain geometry worked out independently of the engine. `lost` is the pieces each side has lost so far (input to promotion under pawn.promotion.targets captured-piece); `error` is a substring of the RulesError the case must raise.
